body.name: Exact positive three-state negative fiber \(\mathfrak W_{2/185}\)
body.construction: Set \(K=3\), \(T=5\), \(g=0\), \(r=1\), \(\mathcal Y=\{0,1\}\), \(\alpha=(3/10,4/10,3/10)\), emission means \((1/5,1/5,4/5)\), \(P=((3/5,3/10,1/10),(1/5,1/2,3/10),(1/10,1/5,7/10))\), \(h=(1/10,3/10,9/20)\), and \(S_{\star}=((9/10,1/10,0),(1/10,9/10,0),(0,0,1))\). The second realization is obtained by \(\alpha'=\alpha S_{\star}\), \(K_0'=S_{\star}^{-1}K_0S_{\star}\), \(h'=S_{\star}^{-1}h\), unchanged emissions, and \(P'=(I_3-\operatorname{diag}(h'))^{-1}K_0'\). The two laws are restricted to the same six observed dates \(0,\ldots,5\), and every treated outcome is the same fixed constant in both realizations.
